diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with base AC, altitude BM = 12 (AM = 5, MC = 9, right angle at M), the dashed arc of the circle centred at C with radius 9 through M and N on BC, and the shaded kite CMZN with Z on the arc; the dashed diagonals CZ and MN are drawn.
